name: Reztori – Digital QR Menu & Contactless Ordering
author: Softiconic

sections.description:
Reztori turns any WordPress page into a QR-code-driven digital menu: customers scan the code on their table, browse your menu, and place an order — all from their own phone’s browser.

See it in action:

  • Live Demo Site: https://qr.softiconic.com/
  • Live Menu Preview: https://qr.softiconic.com/menu/
  • Full Documentation: https://qr.softiconic.com/documentation/

Features

  • Menu Items — name, description, image, price, sold-out toggle, a Recommended/New badge, a vegetarian flag, an optional sale price, weight, prep time, and allergens, organized into categories and tags.
  • Variants & Add-ons — configurable options per item (e.g. Size, Extra Toppings) with their own price adjustments.
  • Tables & QR Codes — add tables and download a PNG or PDF QR code for each one, linking straight to your menu with the table number attached.
  • [rztqm_menu] shortcode — a self-contained, mobile-first digital menu: search, category navigation, tag filters, item detail view, cart, and checkout, dropped into any WordPress page.
  • Orders dashboard — a live kitchen view of incoming orders with status tracking and optional sound/browser notifications.
  • Pay at Counter checkout, with printed receipts for every order.
  • Menu Design — pick a menu template and color theme from the Design screen; every page using the shortcode updates automatically, with no shortcode attributes to manage.
  • Settings — restaurant info, currency, tax, service charge, and notification preferences, all from one screen.
  • Built-in Documentation screen covering every feature.

This plugin is completely free and fully functional on its own — there is no license key to enter and nothing here is time-limited or crippled.

Want more?

Reztori QR Menu Pro is a separate, independently-installed add-on plugin (not distributed through WordPress.org) that builds on this one to add: Multi-Branch locations, Table Sessions & Bill Splitting, Reservations, Waiter Calls, Analytics, a Multi-Language Menu, Online Payments (Stripe & PayPal), and Premium Design (extra menu templates and color themes). It requires this plugin to be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/reztori-qr-menu, or install it directly through Plugins → Add New in wp-admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Reztori QR Menu → Documentation for a full walkthrough (also available online at qr.softiconic.com/documentation), or follow the short version:
    1. Add your menu items under Reztori QR Menu → Add New Item, organized into categories.
    2. Add your tables under Reztori QR Menu → Tables & QR Codes and download a QR code for each.
    3. Create a WordPress page (e.g. “Menu”) and add the [rztqm_menu] shortcode to it.
    4. Fill in your details on Reztori QR Menu → Settings, and pick a look on Reztori QR Menu → Design.
sections.faq:
Do I need to write any code?

No. Add the [rztqm_menu] shortcode to a page and everything else is configured from the Reztori QR Menu admin menu.

Is this plugin really free?

Yes. Menu Items, Tables & QR Codes, the customer-facing menu, Orders, Pay at Counter, and Design all work fully with no license key and no time limit. A separate Reztori QR Menu Pro plugin is available if you want more (see above), but this plugin is not limited or crippled without it.

How do customers pay?

Pay at Counter is available for free. Online card payments via Stripe or PayPal require the separate Reztori QR Menu Pro plugin.

Can I change how the menu looks without editing the shortcode?

Yes. Go to Reztori QR Menu → Design and pick a Menu Template and Color Theme — every page using [rztqm_menu] updates automatically.

Does this support more than one restaurant location?

Not on its own — that requires the separate Reztori QR Menu Pro plugin’s Multi-Branch feature.

Can customers request a table reservation, or call a waiter?

Not with this plugin alone — Reservations and Waiter Calls both ship in the separate Reztori QR Menu Pro plugin.

Is there a live demo I can try before installing?

Yes — try the full customer ordering flow at qr.softiconic.com/menu, or browse qr.softiconic.com for a demo of the whole plugin.

Where can I get help?

Check the built-in Reztori QR Menu → Documentation screen first, the online docs at qr.softiconic.com/documentation, or reach out via our contact page for direct support.
sections.changelog:
1.00

  • Initial release: Menu Items (with variants, add-ons, a Recommended/New badge, vegetarian marking, an optional sale price, weight, prep time, and allergens), Categories & Tags (with an optional category icon image), Tables & QR Codes, the [rztqm_menu] customer menu (with a quick-add “Add” button and a toast confirmation for simple items), the Orders dashboard, Pay at Counter with printed receipts, Menu Design (Template and the Modern Café color theme, with animated card/loading transitions), Settings, and the built-in Documentation screen.
